title: Senior Software Engineer I – Backend
summary: Rightmove is seeking a senior backend engineer to develop reliable services and customer tooling for its property platform. You will work primarily with modern Java and Spring technologies, help shape technical decisions, and improve systems that serve a large UK audience. The role includes collaborative delivery, testing, mentoring, and ownership of production quality.
responsibilities: Design and build scalable backend features
Own technical decisions and projects end to end
Mentor engineers and improve team practices
required_qualifications: Commercial Java and Spring Boot experience
